MINUTES
  MALIBU PLANNING COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 18, 2023
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND TELECONFERENCED
  6:30 P.M.

The following meeting was held in a hybrid format that allowed members of the public to
participate in-person and remotely via Zoom.

CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Peak called the meeting to order at 6:31 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Skylar Peak, Vice Chair John G. Mazza, Commissioners Kraig Hill,
  Jeffrey D. Jennings

  ABSENT: Dennis Robert Smith

  ALSO PRESENT: Pat Donegan, Assistant City Attorney; Richard Mollica, Planning
  Director; Rob DuBoux, Public Works Director; Fletcher Allen, Assistant Planner; Johana
  Valencia, Planning Technician; Parker Davis, Media Technician; and Rebecca Evans,
  Recording Secretary

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Pamela Conley Ulich led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Commissioner Hill seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda as recommended by staff.

  The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Commissioner Smith absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Recording Secretary Evans reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted
  on September 8, 2023. The amended agenda was properly posted on September 14, 2023.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS
  None.
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of September 18, 2023
  Page 2 of 7
  _________________________

ITEM 2.A.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Pamela Conley Ulich commented on an increase in thefts in the Point Dume area
  and asked for City support for license plate reader cameras to be installed in the
  area.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS

  Vice Chair Mazza supported Pamela Conley Ulich’s request and suggested that she
  contact the Public Safety Commission. He asked the Sheriff’s department to make
  residential issues a higher priority and requested additional City funding towards
  increased Sheriff’s Department protection.

  Commissioner Hill requested an update on COVID-19 exposures in City Hall. He
  asked Assistant City Attorney Donegan for an update on the investigation into
  alleged attempts reported in May regarding bribery to influence his decision as a
  Commissioner. He informed the Commission of his interview with Interim City
  Attorney Rusin and noted he had not been provided an update since then.

  In response to Commissioner Hill, Assistant City Attorney Donegan stated he
  would request an update.

  In response to Commissioner Hill, Recording Secretary Evans reported that some
  members of City staff had been exposed to an individual who tested positive for
  COVID-19. Disposable masks were available at the side table to any attendee who
  wished to use one. The use of masks at City Hall remained a personal choice.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  Vice Chair Mazza requested to pull Item Nos. 3.B.3 and 3.B.6.

  Commissioner Hill requested to pull Item Nos. 3.B.4 and 3.B.5.

CONSENSUS Item Nos. 3.B.1. and 3.B.2. were approved by consensus, Commissioner Smith
  absent.

ITEM 4  CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS

RECESS  Chair Peak recessed the meeting at 7:12 p.m. The meeting resumed at 7:23 p.m.
  with Commissioners Peak, Hill, Mazza, and Jennings present and Commissioner
  Smith absent.

ITEM 5  NEW PUBLIC HEARINGS
  A.  Appeal No. 23-006 – Appeal of Planning Director’s denial of Temporary Use Permit
  No. 23-004 for the Malibu Triathlon
  Location:  Zuma Beach, 30050 Pacific Coast Highway
  APN:  4469-027-901
  Owner:  Los Angeles County
  Applicant/Appellant: Super League Triathlon
  Case Planner:  Planning Director Mollica, 456-2489, ext. 346
  Recommended Action: Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-44, denying
  Appeal No. 23-006, and denying Temporary Use Permit No. 23-004 for the Malibu
  Triathlon in the Public Open Space zoning district at 30050 Pacific Coast Highway
  (Los Angeles County).

  Planning Director Mollica presented the staff report.

  Disclosures: Peak, Jennings, Mazza

  Chair Peak opened the public comment portion of the hearing.

  Speakers: Brennan Lindner, Dawn Wilcox, Judy Villablanca, William Celner,
  Colina Stephenson, Pamela Conley Ulich, Mary Kane, Steve Wiseman, Scott
  Hubbou, Jeff Kletter, Laura Webberling, David Weil, Dr. James Armatruda, Rudy
  Garcia Tollson, Paul Hekimian, Mr. Janzen, Anthony McDemas, Bill Sampson,
  Alethea Shih, Zachary Gaidzik, Randi, Jo Drummond, Ryan Embree

  As there were no other speakers present, Chair Peak closed the public comment
  portion of the hearing and returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Commission directed questions to the applicant team and staff.

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Commissioner Hill seconded a motion to adopt
  Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-44, denying Appeal No. 23-006, and
  denying Temporary Use Permit No. 23-004 for the Malibu Triathlon in the Public
  Open Space zoning district at 30050 Pacific Coast Highway (Los Angeles County).
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of September 18, 2023
  Page 7 of 7
  _________________________

  The question was called and the motion failed 2-2, Commissioner Jennings and
  Chair Peak dissenting, Commissioner Smith absent.

MOTION  Chair Peak moved and Commissioner Jennings seconded a motion to grant the
  appeal with the condition that the applicant send out a notification to residents
  within 500 feet of the racecourse and place an ad in the local paper to increase
  public awareness.

  The question was called and the motion failed 2-2, Commissioner Hill and Vice
  Chair Mazza dissenting, Commissioner Smith absent.

  Assistant City Attorney Donegan confirmed the Commissioners were deadlocked
  and therefore the decision of the Planning Director remained in effect. The matter
  could be appealed to the City Council.
